alignment_reasoning: The primary subject (foreground daisy) is exceptionally well-aligned with the class taxonomy. The fine_grained_classifier confirmed 'daisy' with high confidence (logit 8.0). The granular texture of the disc florets and the shape of the ray petals are biologically accurate. artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from minor generative artifacts in the non-focused areas. The background flower exhibits slight haloing/edge bleeding (severity 1.5), and the bottom-left partial flower dissolves into noise rather than maintaining structural integrity (severity 2.0). These are common diffusion model artifacts where attention drops off for peripheral objects. While the main subject is clean, these defects prevent a perfect artifact score. The score is calibrated against Reference 3 (brambling, artifact 4.0) which had cleaner edges; this image is slightly worse due to the fading/collapse issues.
